environment.configuration: Optimized arm64, Swift language mode 5; testable harness with assertions enabled

method.baseline: Snapshot of the prior unreleased concurrent discovery pipeline, including 128 MiB queue and small-folder transactions. This is not the released v0.9.7 baseline.
method.corpus: Local Documents tree; final file count, logical bytes and allocated bytes were identical across all eight runs.
method.conditions: Fresh process and empty isolated cache under /private/tmp for each run. Warm filesystem caches; no builds, tests or source edits during timing. Profile was a separate run before paired measurements.
method.model: Actual production DiskModel, periodic previews and filename cache preparation; excludes SwiftUI rendering, production preferences and existing saved caches.
method.full_inventory_gate: Model root matches expected file count and logical bytes, folder opening finished, producer finished and no deferred directories.
method.core: Initial resumable advance plus publication, followed by reopen/load; no app-model saved-subtree availability hint.
limitations: Two observations per variant and phase; no statistical significance claim.
Warm local tree, not cold or whole-Mac performance.
Durable completion varies with filesystem stalls; no reliable exact saving percentage.
Core discovery ranges overlap; the measured app-model gain cannot be assigned to individual changes.
Earlier experiments used different tree contents and are not this comparison baseline.
Main-actor timer is not a rendered frame measurement.

separate_baseline_profile.tool: macOS sample, 10 seconds at 1 millisecond interval
separate_baseline_profile.interpretation: Sampled stack costs, including blocked filesystem calls, not CPU percentages or end-to-end speedup. Full local profile retained only in the evidence archive.

verification.independent_code_review: No blockers found in cursor lifecycle, buffer ownership, cache-key compatibility or test inclusion.
